title: CLCON/181/2007 of VIRESH KUMAR Vs D.S. TOMAR AND OTHERS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Civil Contempt No. 181 of 2007
Viresh Kumar S/O Sri Maharaj Singh, R/O Village Garhwala, P.O.
Sahanpur, District Bijnore (U.P.)
...... Applicant.
Versus
Shri D.S.Tomar, Managing Director, Uttarakhand Forest
Corporation, Vikash Bhawan-73, Nehru Road, Dehradun and two
others. (Contemnors)
... Respondents.
 Sri S.K.Agrawal, Senior Advocate, with Sri Jitendra Chaudhary, learned counsel
for the applicant.
Sri V.K.Bist, Senior Advocate with Sri V.K.Kaparwan, learned counsel for the
respondents.
Date May 12, 2008.
Hon'ble B.S.Verma, J.
 Sri S.K.Agrawal, Senior Advocate, with Sri Jitendra
Chaudhary, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri V.K.Bist,
Senior Advocate with Sri V.K.Kaparwan, learned counsel for the
respondents.
 Sri S.D.Singh, Regional Manager (Garhwal)
Uttarakhand Forest Development Corporation, Kotdwar, is present
in person.
 Supplementary Counter Affidavit/Compliance Report
has been filed on behalf of the respondents. The same is taken on
record.
 This contempt petition has been filed to punish the
respondents for deliberately flouting the judgment and order dated
26-9-2003 passed by this Court in Writ Petition No. 968 of 2003
(M/S) Viresh Kumar Vs. Presiding Officer, Labour Court,
Dehradun and others.

2
 This Court vide order dated 26-9-2003 has disposed of
the writ petition on the same terms as contained in Writ Petition
No. 1376 of 2001 (M/S), Jabar Singh and others Vs. Presiding
Officer, Labour Court and others, decided on 21-8-2003. The
petitioners were held entitled to continuity in service and
reinstatement by this Court.
 So far as reinstatement of the petitioner is concerned,
the order has been complied with by the Regional Manager
(Garhwal) by his order dated 11-05-2008 (Annexure SCA-1).
 In the circumstances of the case, the contempt petition
is dismissed. Notices issued to the respondents are discharged. It
is provided that if the back wages are not paid by the respondents,
the petitioner would be at liberty to file fresh contempt petition
against the respondents.
All pending applications stand disposed of.
